subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**autonomous**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is discussing a proposal by authorities to improve teaching standards by giving certain colleges more freedom.
 
• The appropriate term should describe colleges having the independent authority to make decisions.
 
• "**Autonomous**" fits well as it denotes self-governance and the ability to operate independently, which aligns with the context of the passage.
 
• Other options ("**automatic**", "**privately**", "**govern**") do not fit the context of describing colleges with independent decision-making power.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The education system is breeding__ more and more frustrations among both students and teachers. And yet no one seems too clear about what can be done to make it more meaningful. **__Many__ reforms have been discussed at length but have come to nothing for one reason or another. The authorities are now peddling the idea of 2 **__autonomous__** colleges as a means of toning up teaching standards. They argue that by allowing certain colleges to introduce their (4) ........ courses, to hold seminars, and above all, to evolve their own method of assessing students, the students will get a far better deal. Indeed, they made out that such colleges will have a free (5) ........ in nearly everything except granting degrees.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Automatic **(स्वचालित): "Automatic" means operating by itself, which does not fit the context of describing colleges with self-governance.
 
• **Privately **(निजी रूप से): "Privately" means in a private manner, which does not align with the context of describing the autonomy of colleges.
 
• **Govern **(शासन करना): "Govern" means to control or influence, which is an action verb and does not fit as an adjective describing the colleges.
